name: Textbox
description: A single-line text field: a real `<input>`, styled by Box props, whose `type` decides its validation, its mobile keyboard and its spinner.

props.name: name
props.description: What the field submits under, and what a `<label htmlFor>` of your own would point at.

props.name: props
props.description: Attributes for the `<input>` itself — an `id`, an `aria-label`, `inputMode`, `autoComplete`.

props.name: onInput
props.description: Fires on every keystroke. `onChange` is React's alias for the same event.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on every keystroke too — React's `onChange` is the DOM's `input`, not its `change`.

props.name: type
props.description: Which text input this is. It decides the validation, the mobile keyboard and the spinner.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: A string is the attribute; an object is `::placeholder` styles. Neither one names the field.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair it with `onChange`, or the field cannot be typed into.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value it starts with when the field owns its own state.

props.name: pattern
props.description: A regular expression the value has to match for the form to be valid.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus it on mount. One per page at most — a stolen focus is a lost place in the document.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Editable to nobody, but still focusable, still read out and still submitted.

props.name: step
props.description: How far a `number` field's spinner and arrow keys move.

keyboard.action: Focuses the field, and Tab again leaves it. Nothing else is intercepted: the caret keys, selection, undo and the clipboard stay the platform's.

a11y: Nothing here names the field. A `placeholder` is not a name — it disappears on the first keystroke — so pair it with a `<label htmlFor>` of your own, or pass `props={{ 'aria-label': … }}`.
`required`, `pattern` and `type` are the platform's own validation, which is announced and translated for free where a check of ours would be neither.
